HEADLINE:
Stellar July preliminary results with EPS reported at NT$50.24, reaching 38% of
Q326 consensus est.
OUR TAKE:

ahead UBSe/Street's 72%/78%, with net profits up 321% YoY. Another record
beat reassuring its leadership and unprecedented margin profile w/ constructive
outlook ahead.

器導軌的龍頭地位，競爭對手至今仍無法撼動，2027年AI伺服器維持成長，加
上新平台放量，且川湖也已準備產能應對，營運將與AI伺服器共榮。

研究部對川湖維持買進投資建議，主係：(1) 2Q26營收與獲利大幅
優於預期，毛利率飆升至87.4%，創歷史新高；(2) 7月單月營收已
站穩60億元以上，管理層對下半年展望正向；(3) 美國廠下半年進
入量產，並持續投入三、五期廠房，面積為二期規模的一倍，未來產
能無虞；(4) 新平台單價大幅提升，川湖產業護城河持續強化。綜上
所述，研究部上修2027年營收至824億元(原估346億元)，年增
56.9%，EPS上修至534.41元(原估207.00元)，給予29倍本益比，
目標價上修至15,500元。

川湖2Q26 營收、獲利大躍進，毛利率表現亮眼，公司表示2H26 持續
有新品量產，營運展望樂觀，且已經與客戶著手規劃2027 年~2029 年
之產品，川湖已在台灣、美國擴產以因應長期需求的攀升。川湖PE 區間
位於10X~28X，考量公司在AI 伺服器市場具主導地位，握有多達3,800
項的專利，建議買進，目標價14,300 元(2027F PE 30X)。

參考區間15～45X 平均值位置，考量27 年新世代GPU 與ASIC 平台持續放
量，高階導軌ASP 及單櫃價值量提升，維持買進投資建議。目標價由9,940
元（30X 修正前FY27E PER）上調至14,250 元（30X 修正後FY27E PER）。

川湖2Q26 財報獲利及7 月營收大幅優於預期。川湖
維持AI 伺服器導軌領導地位，隨著客戶不斷升級AI 伺服器機櫃硬體架構產品，設
計複雜度提高，導軌產品價值提升幅度優於預估，且高市佔率受惠資本支出投入AI
伺服器擴張的趨勢，強勁動能延續至2027 年後。公司新產能的開出，自動化比例
繼續提高，在拓展營收規模的同時，將能維持獲利率水準。預估2026 年/2027 年
稅後EPS 327.67 元/445.79 元。維持買進建議，上修目標價至13,375 元(30 x2027F
EPS)。

投顧上修 2026 、 2027 年稅後 EPS 分別來到 393.72 元
及 612.06 元，依目前股價 11,110 元， PER 18X(2027EPS)
仍顯著落後競爭對手(高達 30X)。法說已定調川益 3 、 5
期新廠建置規劃時程，將提前於今年底開始動工，亦將
確認今明年的營運成長無虞，且產能擴增 2 倍亦為未來
獲利提升想像空間，市場對川湖 2026 、 2027 年營運仍
有再上修空間，依其 2027 年獲利股價仍有再上修至
18,360 元的空間(30X 2027EPS)，故投顧維持買進投資
評等，目標價暫上修至 15,300 元 (25X 2027EPS)(原11,100 元)。

EPS 分別為369.2 元/581.97 元。本中心看好川湖專利護城河，預估川湖AI

Another set of solid results to reassure the market about its
earnings sustainability, entrenched by its dominant industry
position. Stay OW.

We reiterate our Buy rating as the company remains solidly positioned to ride on strong
AI infrastructure builds with evident content gains boosted by design complexity and its
dominant market position. Q226 and July results' solid beat reassures its strong growth/
margin profile with constructive outlook ahead. We lift our 2026/2027/2028 EPS
estimates by 66%/73%/75% and raise our PT to NT$14,000 (30x 2028 PE, down from
prior 33x but in line with AI component leaders at 25-35x consensus P/E).

King Slide delivered another exceptional quarter, significantly exceeding
expectations with 2Q26 GM expanding to 87.4% and July revenue surging 44%
MoM. We believe this was driven by the simultaneous ramp of GB300 and AWS
Trainium3, while demand visibility remains strong across GB300, Vera Rubin,
Trainium3 (with higher liquid cooling adoption), AMD Helios, and general-purpose
servers. Raise TP from NT$10,000 to NT$17,000 and maintain Outperform.

We raise our 2026-27E EPS by 73-149% to factor
in the 2Q26 results. We raise our 12M TP to TWD15,000, based on a PER
of 36x (prior: 30x; higher than its past-3-year range of 9-23x) on our 4-
quarter forward EPS forecast, to reflect a higher earnings trajectory. Thus,
we reaffirm our Buy (1) rating. Key downside risk: weaker-than-expected AI
server demand.

當於2027年每股盈餘的30倍 (2025-27年獲利預估年複合成長率82%)。

間15~45 倍之平均值。考量公司受惠GPU 與ASIC 平台需求成長，帶動高
階伺服器導軌出貨及ASP 提升，以近三年本益比參考區間平均值30 倍作為

Stay OW, raise PT to NT$10,000: We believe King Slide's superior profitability, i.e.,
GM of 75-80% and OPM of 70-75%, is reflection of its competitiveness entrenched
by a comprehensive patent portfolio, solid execution and strong customer
relationships. We are of the view that its margins are sustainable or could even
expand gradually in the coming years, but we note that its earnings growth seems to
be driven more by the top-line growth given the relative high base in its profitability.
We raise our 2026-28 earnings estimates by 50-73% to mainly factor in stronger
revenue growth assumptions; our PT increases to NT$10,000 (from NT$6,650),
based on a 30x 2027e P/E (from 34x to factor in the volatile sentiment toward AI),
implying a PEG of 0.5 off our 56% operating profit CAGR for 2026-28e.

King Slide’s Jun revenue was up 221% YoY / 17% MoM, leading the
company’s 2Q26 revenue 60% / 41% higher than our estimate /
Bloomberg consensus. The strong revenue growth in Jun reaffirms 
our positive view on King Slide’s leading market position, AI servers 
ramp up with specification upgrade and rising non-computing IT 
racks in AI data center to support AI workloads (e.g. storage servers, 
CPU servers, LPU rack, power rack, cooling rack, networking rack, 
CPO switch rack, etc.), enlarging rail kits addressable market. We 
raise our 12m TP to NT$12,000 (from NT$7,664 previously) with 
higher net income in 39% / 36% / 48% in 2026E-28E and target P/E 
multiple from 30x to 34.5x on the stronger earnings growth in
forward years. Maintain Buy.

此次分別上修川湖2026/2027 年EPS 28%/34%，主因xAI 以及AWS 拉貨
動能優於預期，上調2026/2027 年GB300/VR 出貨櫃數24%/33%至6.8/8.0
萬櫃，上修川湖營收預估，預估2026/2027 年EPS 分別為239.4 元/336.4
元。隨多款AI 新機種放量，以及北美新產能於2H26 陸續開出，皆有利後續
營運上修空間。因此以2027 年EPS 336.4 元給予32 倍本益比，推得目標
價10,800 元，維持買進建議 (較前次30 倍上調)。

We expect a positive market reaction in the near term to the strong June/2Q26 sales. We
lift our 2026-28E EPS by 16-29% mainly to reflect our higher sales estimates following
the record-high June/2Q26 numbers. We fine-tune but maintain our GM/OPM 
assumptions at 76.8-76.9%/69.9-70.5%. We keep in mind mgmt.’s guidance for 1.5-
2.0ppt margin fluctuation, as the company maintains its natural FX hedge policy and 
allows for any material cost hikes (e.g. for steel). We raise our PO to NT$9,100 from 
NT$7,600 with valuation unchanged at 30x 2027E EPS. We reiterate our Buy rating on 
King Slide as the top server rail leader with solid sales growth.

Lift price target to NT$8,950; maintain Buy:
We remain positive on stronger AI spending and rising rail kit content/requirements,
raising our 2026E/2027E/2028E EPS 19%/29%/35% and lifting our PT to NT
$8,950 (from 30x 2027E PE to 33x 2028E PE), in line with global/Asian peers' re-ratings 
to 30-40x and similar to other AI component leaders, such as Delta/Jentech (31x/31x
consensus 2027 PE). We still view King Slide as a strong proxy for server growth.

目標價由6,350元調升至8,850元，基於30倍2027年EPS預估 (2025-27
年EPS CAGR達66%)，因AI伺服器機櫃需求成長將帶動滑軌需求。維持
「增加持股」評等。

隨著AI 機櫃功耗及重量持續增加，市場對高承重、高可靠度導軌需求同步
提升，亦有利川湖持續擴大技術領先優勢，預估川湖AI 導軌市佔率仍將高
於80%，2025-2028 年營收CAGR 達53%。此次分別上修川湖2026/2027
年EPS 19%/32%，主因多款AI 伺服器新機種放量，整體拉貨動能優於預期，
預估2026/2027 年EPS 分別為187.8 元/251.0 元，以2027 年EPS 251 元
給予30 倍PE，推得目標價7,500 元，維持買進建議 (與前次評價相同)。

We focus on King Slide's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price movement.
Details:
1. May sales were NT$3,791mn (+46% MoM/+172% YoY) – another record high.
2. QTD revenue reached 89% of MSe at NT$7,211mn (+32% QoQ/+71% YoY)
and 91% of consensus at NT$7,016mn (+29% QoQ/+66% YoY).
Our view:
1. We see 2Q26 revenue tracking significantly ahead of the market's
expectations.
2. We believe the meaningful sequential top-line growth in the past two
months was mainly driven by multiple projects, and we expect the
momentum to sustain in the coming quarters as customers ramp new
models in 2H26 and more devices adopt rail kits.
3. We believe King Slide should continue to benefit from server market growth
and increasing dollar content, driven by more complex designs and broader
adoption of rail kits. We view it as a good proxy for the AI capex cycle, given
its dominant position, strong patent portfolio, and solid execution.

King Slide April revenues increased by 35% MoM/ 79% YoY to NT$2.6bn, or 16% 
ahead of estimates, and we attribute it to AI server rail kit ramp up and general 
server rail kit growth. The strong growth echos our positive view on company’s 
leading market positions in AI server rail kits, supported by its comprehensive 
architecture across rack/ baseboard/ ASIC, strong patents (~3.7k patents approved 
as of May 2026), diversified client group, and its high customization ability. Amid the 
larger revenues scale, the company’s 1Q26 GM was up to 77.7% (vs. 76.0% in 2025) 
with automated production and strong cost control, and the company continues the 
capacity expansion to capture the growth opportunities. Maintain Buy with TP raised 
to NT$7,664.

We raise our 2026-27E EPS by 21-27% to factor in
the 1Q26 results. Therefore, we raise our 12M TP to TWD5,888, based on
a PER of 30x (high end of its past-3-year range of 10-32x; raised from 26x

We believe the company's strong financial performance should
alleviate market concerns around its earnings sustainability.
1Q26 GM beat:
1. Off revenue of NT$5,450mn (+10% QoQ/+38% YoY), GM expanded 1.6ppt
QoQ to 77.7% (record high; vs. MSe/consensus at 76.1%/76.6%) owing to a
more favorable product mix and FX tailwinds.
2. Opex was NT$582mn (opex ratio 10.7%), above our estimate of NT$376mn
(opex ratio 7.1%) and consensus of NT$392mn (opex ratio 7.6%), largely
owing to higher freight costs, which will likely be reimbursed in the coming
quarters.
3. Operating profit came in at NT$3,654mn (+7% QoQ/+34% YoY; OPM -2.1ppt
QoQ to 67.1%), in line with MSe of NT$3,672mn (OPM 69.0%) but 3% higher
